author: huego
body: is it possible to make the monument that you are supposed to destroy/defend multiple blocks/blocks that are not obsidian? eg if i wanted to make it so that you have to a few blocks that are made out of wood instead of one block that is obsidian

title: Question About Destroy the Monument

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I know that the Overcast Network has a "monument mode" that changes the obsidian monument into emerald blocks and then to coal over time to prevent 3+hour stalemating.

So yes, it is possible to have monuments that aren't made out of obsidian.
